title: Project initialization and configuration loading
description:
Implement .kanbus.yml loading and validation, project/ directory structure creation (kanbus init), hierarchy/workflow/status/priority configuration parsing, and JSON serialization with byte-for-byte parity (sorted keys, 2-space indent, RFC3339 timestamps). Nearly every other feature file starts with 'Given a Kanbus project with default configuration', so this epic unblocks everything downstream.

Spec coverage target: features/initialization/ (1), features/configuration/ (7) -- 8 feature files.
